scenario: data-load-performance/Layout and page read the same data
reason: React's per-request cache() only dedupes inside a real request scope. The Jest harness mocks cache() to an identity function so server modules can load under jsdom, so request-scoped memoization cannot be observed there.
Requires two separate request scopes to observe that memoization does not leak between them. Jest has no request boundary, and the e2e layer cannot see per-request query counts.
